title: Kooky Crispy Saudi Arabian Fish Kebabs
description: A crispy and spicy pescatarian dish featuring scotch bonnet peppers, perfect for a hangover cure, with a winey twist. This Saudi Arabian inspired fish kebab is cut in the katsuramuki style for a unique presentation.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together flour, cornstarch, salt, and black pepper.
Dip each piece of fish into the flour mixture, then the eggs, and finally the flour mixture again.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and sear the fish until golden brown.
Transfer the fish to a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes.
In the same pan, add the diced scotch bonnet peppers and cook until softened.
Add the white wine to the pan and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Thread the fish onto skewers and serve with the pepper and wine sauce.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
